Glossary
Anthropometrics Body measurements used to determine body fat composition.
Bioelectrical impedance A method that uses a small electrical current to measure body composition.
DEXA scan A dual energy X-ray absorptiometry scan that uses X-ray beams to measure bone density and/or body composition.
Endoscopy A procedure that uses an instrument to look inside the body for diagnostic or therapeutic purposes.
